text: If we want to make law enforcement strong and effective again, we have to take a hard look at the whole federal justice system. That means reorganizing how it operates, cutting through the red tape, and maybe even setting up new, specialized courts. We also need to get better at how we pick juries, and seriously streamline our investigative and prosecutorial teams. At the end of the day, it's about one thing: making sure justice is both swift and certain.
